scientific_integrity: An exact eight-state Kummer carry model and two independently checked integer-polynomial resolvent identities establish the unrestricted rational enumeration; the asymptotic follows from a double golden-ratio pole.
scientific_limitations: Only the exact valuation-one dyadic-block census for five-ary Fuss–Catalan coefficients is claimed. The parity law and general carry method are prior results; higher valuation shells and arbitrary arities are not classified. Global priority is not certified.
title: Exact first binary valuation shell of five-ary Fuss–Catalan numbers
